question: What is the closest meaning of the word "labyrinthine" as used in the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. mysterious and confusingly complex.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"labyrinthine"** means:

 
 
• Like a labyrinth; irregular and twisting. (जटिल, उलझा हुआ)
 
• Complex and confusingly intricate. (रहस्यमय और अव्यवस्थित)
 
 
 
• The closest meaning of "labyrinthine" is **"mysterious and confusingly complex."**
 
• **Example from the passage:** The labyrinthine corridors of the ancient castle were easy to get lost in.
 
 
• **Example:** The plot of the novel was so labyrinthine that it left readers guessing until the end.
 
 

Therefore, the closest meaning of “labyrinthine” is: **mysterious and confusingly complex.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Superficial and obvious** (सतही और स्पष्ट): Lacking depth; easily understood or seen.

 
 
• **Example:** The solution to the problem was superficial and obvious, requiring no deep thinking.
 
 
 
• **Predictable and linear** (पूर्वानुमान करने योग्य और सरल): Easily foreseen and straightforward in progression.
 
 
• **Example:** The storyline was predictable and linear, without any surprising twists.
 
 
 
• **Structured and disciplined** (संरचित और अनुशासित): Organized and following a strict set of rules or patterns.
 
 
• **Example:** The team's approach was structured and disciplined, leading to consistent results.
